This is the bottom is blue and then the top should be red Yeah

The blue block is oriented with its longest dimension (4 units) along the x-axis to span the front row, consistent with the 'horizontal blue' part of the L-shape prior, resolving the ambiguity with 'long side facing you'.
The phrase "Bottom right corner" refers to the grid cell x=[2,4], z=[2,4].
The second red block is stacked directly on top of the first red block, aligned with it.
